evidence: 150 mm (100) silicon wafers were used as substrate after cleaning with the standard RCA-cleaning sequence: SC-1, HF-dip and SC-2 ("RCASi substrate"). Thermal dry oxidation with O2 was made for some wafers in a Centrotherm furnace at 1050 /compBC for 90 min, targeting an oxide thickness of 100 nm ("SiO2 substrate").
